findings.location: #body, <body> element, page level: the only navigation mechanism present is nav#nav, line 8
findings.evidence: nav#nav contains 2 links (Plan a trip, Accessibility); no search form, sitemap, or breadcrumb trail appears anywhere in the document; footer#footer contains only Privacy policy and Terms of service links.
findings.violation: The page relies solely on the primary navigation menu, nav#nav, as its only way to locate this page or reach related content: no site search, sitemap, or breadcrumb trail is present anywhere in the document, and nothing in the page's content marks it as one step in a linear process.
findings.fix: Add a second independent navigation mechanism, such as a site search form or a breadcrumb trail, so a reader who lands directly on this page has more than one way to find related pages.
